mapping.summary: Optimises cutting of bars, profiles and reels to length and stocks remnants.
claims: Cut orders come from production orders, sales orders or manual entry
Optimiser uses remnants first, then open reels, then stock bars
Accounts for kerf, end trim and a maximum number of cuts per bar
Reports uncovered demand as a shortfall to purchase
Cutting plans are approved and printed for the saw
Operators scan bars on a phone, confirm cuts and enter measured offcuts
Posting consumes material, receives pieces and stores offcuts as remnants, optionally lot-tracked with length
Remnant board shows length, lot, location and age with QR labels
Remnants are netted before purchasing and traced to heat, batch or reel
Ten industry profiles ship with the app
External optimisers can be plugged in; an OptiCutter connector exists
Does not do true-shape CAD/CAM nesting
Needs BC 28 or later; production order demand needs Premium
Licensed per user with separate shop floor and planner plans
